subject.title: [Bug] Webchat avatar endpoint /avatar/{agentId} returns 404 even with valid IDENTITY.md avatar

question: What should Control UI expose when a workspace avatar is missing, too large, unsupported, or outside the workspace?
rationale: The useful remaining change is no longer basic local avatar serving; it is how much local-file failure detail the gateway and browser UI should reveal without weakening workspace containment or leaking sensitive paths.

options.title: Expose bounded diagnostics
options.body: Return and render safe reason codes such as `too_large` with the configured limit while redacting absolute paths and remote URL details.

options.title: Keep generic missing behavior
options.body: Preserve the current 404/missing-avatar behavior to minimize disclosure, accepting the existing UX friction.

options.title: Settle the linked PR first
options.body: Close or replace the conflicting fork PR before deciding whether a smaller diagnostics-only change should proceed.

recommendation.title: Expose bounded diagnostics
recommendation.body: Return and render safe reason codes such as `too_large` with the configured limit while redacting absolute paths and remote URL details.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest history across avatar support, validation, Control UI route hardening, and the security boundary this decision affects.
